unresolvedReferences.description: The emperor in s0013, s0025, s0026, and s0027, His Majesty and Duke of Daxing in s0031, and the Supreme One in s0037 and s0044 follow Gaozu's taking the throne in s0010. Treated as Gaozu. Strongly inferred. Not inferred from a reign name.
天子 / the Son of Heaven is wording on a stone turtle. He is not identified with Gaozu. The inscription does not name him.
The house of Yang, and Yang on the iron plate, are an omen clan name. They are not entered as a person and are not given a personal name.
楊樹 is kept as the English poplar. It is not recorded as the surname Yang.
保定二年，歲在壬午，五月五日 is kept unresolved. Baoding is not in the packet reign table. No Western year is recorded.
是月 is kept unresolved as the same month as the previous unit. 歷年二十 is not converted into a year.
開皇初 is kept unresolved. Kaihuang is not in the packet reign table. No Western year is recorded.
高祖受禪 is kept unresolved. The unit gives no year.

The memorial's wording about the four divisions of the year and the five divisions of the year is not copied into a claim, because claim text cannot contain that substring. The Chinese 四時 and 五時 remain the packet's.

尚書僕射 is kept under the packet English Minister of the Works. 通直散騎侍郎 is kept as Tongzhi Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary. 內史侍郎 is kept as Internal History Vice Minister. No title was normalized.
皇始 is wording on the iron plate. It is not used as an event date and is not converted.
Your servant and 臣 are the memorial speaker. Shao is not named until s0105. Treated as Wang Shao because s0104 rewards him and s0105 has Shao submit the next memorial.
The emperor who reads the memorial is the same His Majesty addressed as 至尊. This chunk never uses the temple name Gaozu, so he is not renamed here.
His Majesty is the heir, 世子, of the Duke of Chenliu. s0088 enfeoffs Emperor Wuyuan as that duke. Wuyuan is treated as his father. Strongly inferred across the two units.

The Heavenly King of Chenliu in the Qi prophecy is not named. s0091 says Emperor Wuyuan later entered Bing Province. The prophecy's king is treated as Wuyuan. Peng Le, a different Prince of Chenliu, was the man Gao Yang killed.
Min, Ming, Wu, Xuan, and Jing are kept as the packet's short forms. They are not expanded. Wu in this list is treated as Emperor Wu of Zhou, named in full in s0092.
Wuyuan's taboo name is not written. Gong and gong are pitch names in the prophecy. They are not recorded as his personal name.
辛酉歲 is kept unresolved. No Western year is recorded. The Yang clan is his clan by the pairing in this sentence; no personal name is added.
建德六年 is kept unresolved. Jiande is not in the packet reign table.
大象元年夏 is kept unresolved. Daxiang is not in the packet reign table. The summer wording is not given a Western year.
大統十六年 is kept unresolved. Datong is not in the packet reign table.
六年 has no era name. None is supplied, and no Western year is recorded.
天子氣, the qi of an emperor, is not identified with His Majesty. The unit does not say whose qi it was. Hedouling Gong keeps the packet spelling.
Great Peace and 太平 are the chart's age of peace. They are not mapped to the Liao Taiping entry in the packet reign table.
The five princes are entered under Zhao, Chen, Dai, Yue, and Teng only. No personal names and no polity are added.
The three boys who sang are unnamed and are not entered as people.
s0048 大周村 is Dazhou Village. s0053 周村 is Zhou Village. The wording is kept as written and not emended.
Your servant is Wang Shao, named Shao in the previous unit as the sender of this memorial. This chunk does not repeat the name Shao or 王劭.
His Majesty is not given a temple name in this chunk. He is not renamed from another chunk.

The emperor whose daughter Princess Leping is, 皇帝, is treated as His Majesty, the ruler this memorial is explaining. Strongly inferred. She is not given a personal name. Empress of Zhou is her title, not a second person.
The True Man, and the divine man from Zhongshan, are read by the memorial as His Majesty. Pinzhi is kept as the packet's mistaken writing and is not entered as a person.
楊氏 is the Yang family. Cosmic yang in Yang virtue is not a person. No personal name is added.
二月 for the accession is kept unresolved. No era name is supplied and no Western year is recorded.
六月 as the birth month is kept unresolved. No year is given.
五月 as Emperor Xuan's death month is kept unresolved. No year is given.
踰年 is not converted into a year.
十一月 for the Bozhou command is kept unresolved. No era name is supplied.
曆數, the destined number of years, is not recorded as a Western year.
The memorial calls Pinzhi a wrong character for True Man. The translation already says so. No repair was made.
Your servant is Shao, named later in s0178. The memorial is continuous.
His Majesty is the emperor who later favors Shao. This chunk does not use a temple name, so none is added.

The crown prince installed in s0173 is read as the former heir of s0174, 前東宮, because s0174 contrasts that heir with the present crown prince, 今皇太子. Neither personal name is given. They are not called sons by a kinship term.
The Red Emperor, the Spirit Emperor, and the Great Spirit Heavenly Emperor are portent powers, not His Majesty. The star offices in s0186, including the Emperor and the Four Emperors, are not people.
Suí Huang keeps the packet accent. Fuxi is the packet's Fuxi for 伏戲. The Three Sovereigns are not split into named persons.

The stone is said to bear the emperor's personal and family names. The characters of the personal name are not written. Only Yang, 楊, is recorded, as the surname the stone pairs with ten thousand years.
The two characters for empress on the stone are not identified with Empress Wenxian.
Miaoshan is kept as Shao's citation of secret scriptures. No other name is added for Empress Wenxian.
開皇 is kept unresolved, including the Kaihuang year in the Lingbao Scripture. It is not mapped to the Liao Taiping or Da'an entries, and no Western year is recorded.
仁壽中 is kept unresolved. Renshou is not in the packet reign table. No Western year is recorded.
八月二十二日, 二十三日, and 二十四日卯時 are kept unresolved. No year is supplied from the preceding Renshou phrase.
旬朔, more than ten days, is a span of days, not a year.
The emperor who dies in s0221 is not given a temple name. Emperor Yang succeeds him in s0223. The two are not merged.
The emperor in Yuan Chong's biography is not named. He is not identified with the emperor who dies in s0221, and he is not called Emperor Yang. The crown prince is not named.
The five sons are not named. Prince Xiu is not explicitly called one of them.
Prince Liang's kinship to Emperor Yang is not stated. Shao's request to change Liang's surname was not followed, and no new surname is recorded.
Peng Zu and Old Master Li are comparisons. They are not Cui Peng and Li Sheng. Old Master Li is not renamed Laozi.
Yan is the younger uterine brother. Guan's exact tie to the Duke of Zhou is only blood kinship, and no tighter term is added.
Shu Xiang and Shu Yu, and Shi Que and Shi Hou, are not given a tighter kinship than the judgments state. Confucius is the packet's English for 仲尼. Zuo Qiuming is the packet's English for 丘明.
The Five Guan and the Three Overseers are groups. Their members are not named.
其年 is kept unresolved. No era is named.
開皇元年 is kept unresolved. No Western year is recorded.
十七年, 四年, 二年, and 十六年 do not name an era in their own units. Kaihuang is not filled in from s0256, and no Western year is recorded.
仁壽初 is kept unresolved. The emperor's birth month and day are said to match, but the numbers are not given and none are supplied.
大安 is Shao's wording for lofty peace in the dream. It is not the Liao Da'an reign in the packet table.
Great Peace is Jing Fang's phrase for an age. It is not mapped to the Liao Taiping reign.
Nearly twenty years in the Writing Office is not turned into a pair of years.
The guest who quoted the Odes is unnamed and is not entered as a person.
The emperor who accedes in this sentence is Emperor Yang, named in the same unit. Your Majesty later in the memorial is the same ruler.

殺逆 is Yuwen Huaji's regicide. Chong's execution is explicit. Emperor Yang's death is strongly inferred because the regicide is of the reigning emperor, who in this chunk is Yang. The text does not say the words of his death.
仁壽四年甲子歲 is kept unresolved. No Western year is recorded.
丙辰 and 丙子 are cyclical dates for Yao. They are not converted. His forty-ninth year is not turned into a Western year.
大業六年 is kept unresolved. Daye is not in the packet reign table.
The month and day portents, including 去八月二十八日 and 去年十一月二十日, name no era. None is filled in from Daye, and no Western year is recorded.
武德 is the station where the Celestial Eye dwells. It is not treated as a reign year and is not converted.
Fangxun is kept as the packet's name and joined to Yao, Tang Yao, and Emperor Yao. Upper Origin is a cycle in the memorial, not a reign in the packet table.
Prince Yang of Qi keeps the packet English for 齊王暕. He is not Emperor Yang.
董 is Dong Hu. 遷 is Sima Qian and 固 is Ban Gu, using the packet English. The characters 司馬遷 and 班固 are not in the Chinese, so they are not added. 南, the southern annalists, are not named one by one.
The memorial's phrase about what comes afterward being offered at the proper time is not copied, because a claim cannot contain that substring.
The candidate 二月 sits inside 十二月. It is not a separate second month.
七十五 is an age at death, not a Western year.
The historiographer, 史臣, is unnamed and is not entered as a person. The comment is marked as the historian's judgment.
